oneOf.description: Template expression that resolves to ClockIn, ClockOut, BreakStart or BreakEnd

type.description: Punch type. Valid transitions: Off → ClockIn; Working → BreakStart or ClockOut; OnBreak → BreakEnd or ClockOut.

note.description: Optional note stored with the punch. Template expressions are allowed.

timePunch.description: Time clock (mobile): manual punch for Clock in / Break / End break / Clock out buttons. Works offline (the punch is queued). Stops the action chain, with a toast, when the punch is not a valid transition from the current clock state ({{ clockState.state }}), when the type does not resolve to a punch type, or when the punch could not be saved.
